About this item

  • 【Space Saving& Large Capacity】With one door and 2 open cabints design, our modern floating tv shelf has large storage. The floating design of the wall-mounted tv cabinet does not occupy too much space and can free up the floor space. It can be used to display and store multiple shelves, routers, set-top boxes, ideal for DVD players, CDs, remote controls, projectors, small decorations, game consoles, TV components and decorations.
  • 【Easy to Assemble & Put Together】Our tv floating shelf can be easily installed using the included hardware, tools and instructions. Compatible with solid wood, wood or gypsum walls (not applicable to dry walls, cavity walls, gypsum board walls). If you have any installation problems or other questions, please feel free to contact us, we will help you any time asap.
  • 【Waterproof & Durable】Made from solid plywood panel, our floating media console is waterproof, scratch-resistant and easy to clean. The floating entertainment shelf equipped with qaulity standard wall-mounted installation accessories and wooden nails, which made it durable! With smooth finish made it is very easy to keep the furniture unit as shiny as new.
  • 【Packages & Service】Packages: 1* tv floating shelf,1*screw bag,1*direction.Comes with 7 layers of cardboard boxes and crumbly Styrofoam panels ensure the floating tv console stays safe on its long journey.PLease feel free to contact us if there is any damages or lost accessories, we will help you 7/24 hours.
  • 【Modern & Rounded Coner Design】The floating TV shelf is simple modern in design and can easily complement any room or furniture style. Add some vitality and vigor to your bedroom, living room, media room and office.Designed with round corner, the wall mounted floating tv stand will provide you a safe and healthy living environment.

Pmnianhua floating tv shelf

  • Upgrade your home entertainment setup with the Pmnianhua Floating TV Stand.
  • Made from high-quality plywood, this modern and functional media console is designed to provide a minimalist and space-saving solution for your TV and media devices.
  • One of the standout features of this floating TV stand is its wire management system. With wire holes and a router hole design, you can easily organize and hide your cables, keeping your space tidy and clutter-free.
  • The included door provides easy access to your media devices, while also hiding messy wires, giving your space a clean and organized look.
  • The Floating TV Shelf is built to last, with a scratch-resistant and water-resistant surface that ensures durability and long-lasting use. Its sturdy construction can safely support your TV and media devices, providing you with peace of mind.
  • Installation is a breeze with all necessary hardware included. Simply mount it to your wall to create a floating effect that adds a modern touch to your space.
  • This sleek and stylish wall mount TV shelf is designed to be wall-mounted, creating a clean and minimalist look in your living room.

    It was tricky to put together because the instructions graphics were too busy to be able to see exactly what went where. It would have been great to have a paper template for the back hole placement (so masking tape to mark out is the next best option).

    We were missing a screw for the handle, and there’s no option to connect with the seller directly to request a missing part. Amazon offered me $5 via a balance to my account, but this somewhat doesn’t make up for me now needing to make a trip to a hardware store to find a singular screw (or, a new handle entirely if I can’t find the correct screw - not the end of the world, the handle is cheap).

    Having said that, the shelf itself is lovely and sturdy. The centre fold-down door is an odd colour choice and the handle isn’t aesthetically pleasing.

    In other words, mostly good but some improvements to be made.

About this Item

  • 【Space Saving& Large Capacity】With one door and 2 open cabints design, our modern floating tv shelf has large storage. The floating design of the wall-mounted tv cabinet does not occupy too much space and can free up the floor space. It can be used to display and store multiple shelves, routers, set-top boxes, ideal for DVD players, CDs, remote controls, projectors, small decorations, game consoles, TV components and decorations.
  • 【Easy to Assemble & Put Together】Our tv floating shelf can be easily installed using the included hardware, tools and instructions. Compatible with solid wood, wood or gypsum walls (not applicable to dry walls, cavity walls, gypsum board walls). If you have any installation problems or other questions, please feel free to contact us, we will help you any time asap.
  • 【Waterproof & Durable】Made from solid plywood panel, our floating media console is waterproof, scratch-resistant and easy to clean. The floating entertainment shelf equipped with qaulity standard wall-mounted installation accessories and wooden nails, which made it durable! With smooth finish made it is very easy to keep the furniture unit as shiny as new.
  • 【Packages & Service】Packages: 1* tv floating shelf,1*screw bag,1*direction.Comes with 7 layers of cardboard boxes and crumbly Styrofoam panels ensure the floating tv console stays safe on its long journey.PLease feel free to contact us if there is any damages or lost accessories, we will help you 7/24 hours.
  • 【Modern & Rounded Coner Design】The floating TV shelf is simple modern in design and can easily complement any room or furniture style. Add some vitality and vigor to your bedroom, living room, media room and office.Designed with round corner, the wall mounted floating tv stand will provide you a safe and healthy living environment.

Product description

Upgrade your entertainment space with our sleek and functional Modern Floating TV Cabinet. Designed for style and convenience, this wall-mounted TV cabinet is crafted from high-quality white plywood, ensuring durability and a clean aesthetic. With its round corners and minimalist design, it seamlessly complements modern interiors while providing ample storage and organization. Elevate your entertainment experience and create a modern focal point in your home with the Modern Floating TV Cabinet. Its clean lines, functional features, and premium materials make it an essential addition to any contemporary living space.
